reader_question: Which crates are proven mostly by real integration tests, and which lean on unit tests alone?
title: CredMgr V2 — test tier by crate
subtitle: Percent of each crate's suite that is an integration test (real broker socket, real subprocess) vs. a unit test
text_summary: credmgr-cli is proven entirely by integration tests (broker/MCP subprocess round trips, 0% unit). credmgr-keystore and credmgr-store are proven entirely by unit tests (0% integration) — neither needs a live broker to exercise. credmgr-brokerd sits at 84% integration, reflecting the isolation suite's own convention of driving real dispatch calls rather than hand-built scopes.
